claim: The gateway calls pos_item_sales: AnalyticsService.loadTill reads it beside pos_cost_of_goods for the financial summary's net sales and the ratios built on the cost of what sold (ADR 0298 decisions 1 to 8; cost-math lane 3.1, PRs #1025 to #1036). Any non-test source under apps, services or packages naming the function, in any spelling of the call, holds it; generated database types and fixtures do not. Resolved 2026-11-11: it had stayed open after the reader landed, which the claims check reported as STALE.

Open until the digest's PR, the last of ADR 0298's split, composes the digest for the house's sales holders (decision 9) and flips this row to resolved. The digest is composed in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/digest/ (recommendation-digest.service.ts on main); the reader is readSalesHolderIds in apps/api-gateway/src/notifications/producers/sales-holders.ts. Any non-test file of the digest's directory that names the reader or imports its module holds it.
